guard: the re-exec argv builder accepts only an entry that resolves to the cotal-ai package's own entry, refuses a foreign file that merely carries the name, and still accepts the three shapes a real install runs under
why: #1629: a fixture under tsx has `process.argv[1]` pointing at the suite, so the detached manager
`startManagerDetached` spawns IS the suite. On a persistent host that produced 970 generations
in 4.7 hours, each holding a nats-server and a delivery holder. The child is unref'd by design,
so no teardown owner can adopt it and the refusal has to be where the argv is built.
Both directions are mutated. FALSE ACCEPT: the first cut of this guard compared only the file
NAME, so any `cotal.ts` or `cotal.js` anywhere was accepted and could re-exec itself the same way;
the name rule, its bare-`cotal` half, the package-name check and the exact-file comparison each
FALSE REFUSE: `npm i -g cotal-ai` publishes `<prefix>/bin/cotal` as a SYMLINK and Node leaves
argv[1] on the link, so a guard that stopped resolving it would refuse every global install's
manager start while still passing the headline cell. Dropping either accepted entry file
(the declared bin, or the checkout's `bin/cotal.ts`) is mutated for the same reason.

mutations.name: the guard is removed and any entry builds a re-exec argv again
mutations.cell: a `.smoke.ts` entry is REFUSED, not re-execed as a daemon
mutations.expectRed: a `.smoke.ts` entry is REFUSED, not re-execed as a daemon

mutations.name: the entry is accepted by its file name again, so a foreign `cotal.ts` passes
mutations.cell: a foreign file named `cotal.ts` is REFUSED, not re-execed as a daemon
mutations.expectRed: a foreign file named `cotal.ts` is REFUSED, not re-execed as a daemon

mutations.name: a bare `cotal` is trusted by its name again, as the global-install shape once was
mutations.cell: a foreign file named bare `cotal` is refused too
mutations.expectRed: a foreign file named bare `cotal` is refused too

mutations.name: the package name is not checked, so any manifest declaring a cotal bin passes
mutations.cell: a `cotal.ts` beside a manifest that is not cotal-ai's is refused
mutations.expectRed: a `cotal.ts` beside a manifest that is not cotal-ai's is refused

mutations.name: any file inside the cotal-ai package passes, not only its entries
mutations.cell: a `cotal.js` inside the cotal-ai package that is not its declared bin is refused
mutations.expectRed: a `cotal.js` inside the cotal-ai package that is not its declared bin is refused

mutations.name: the entry is not resolved, so a global install's bin symlink is refused
mutations.cell: a bare `cotal` bin symlink (the global-install shape) builds a re-exec argv
mutations.expectRed: a bare `cotal` bin symlink (the global-install shape) builds a re-exec argv

mutations.name: the checkout entry is dropped, so `pnpm cotal` can no longer start a daemon
mutations.cell: the repo's own `bin/cotal.ts` builds a re-exec argv ending in that entry
mutations.expectRed: the repo's own `bin/cotal.ts` builds a re-exec argv ending in that entry

mutations.name: the declared bin is dropped, so an installed `dist/cotal.js` is refused
mutations.cell: the package's declared bin `dist/cotal.js` builds one too
mutations.expectRed: the package's declared bin `dist/cotal.js` builds one too
